## LmdbSchema.hookBeforeRead property

Optional read hook — converts the stored form back to a typed row.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static hookBeforeRead?: (raw: unknown) => unknown;
```

## Remarks

Runs after LMDB deserializes the value (like a collection codec's `deserialize`<!-- -->). Must be declared together with [LmdbSchema.hookBeforeWrite](./lmdb.lmdbschema.hookbeforewrite.md) — declaring only one of the pair throws at registration.
